### 1. Historical Echoes
- **Napoleonic Wars & Congress of Vienna (1815):** Some historians argue that the massive scale of these wars forced European powers to adopt new diplomatic frameworks (the Concert of Europe) aimed at preventing large‑scale warfare thereafter.

| Aspect | Typical Strengths of Formal Education | How Hands‑On Experience Adds Value |
